description: Poll the status of an OpusClip censor job. Status values: "QUEUED" / "PROCESSING" (still running, poll again), "CONCLUDED" (success), "FAILED" (check error), "UNKNOWN" (Opus could not determine the state — surfaced as UPSTREAM_STATUS_UNKNOWN). The response includes `next_poll_after_seconds` honouring Retry-After when present.

attempt.description: Current attempt number (used for exponential backoff when Retry-After is absent). Starts at 1.

name: opus_get_censor_job_status
